_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S5 Joovy). Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Joovy Zoom 360 Ultralight

clekListed.clekRow: Joovy Zoom 360 Ultralight / Joovy Zoom — Universal Car Seat Adapter

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: ~3 mo (6 mo+ for jogging); newborn with an infant car seat via adapter

safety.standards: US federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833 (mandatory for US strollers); Clek confirms all listed strollers were tested to the applicable ASTM standards for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; lockable swiveling front wheel; rear-wheel suspension; wrist strap. Joovy does not publish a per-model JPMA certification.

recall.summary: CPSC Recall Alert: ~9,200 Joovy Zoom 360 Ultralight jogging strollers recalled for a fall/injury hazard — the front wheel fork bearing can fail or detach (25 incidents, 12 detachments, 1 fall with bruises). Scoped to SKUs 8060, 8061, 8067, 8069 with batch numbers 03-XX-20 through 10-XX-20 (sold May-Dec 2020). Remedy: free repair kit replacing the front wheel fork bearing. Later production and other SKUs are outside the recall.

specs.tires: 16 in rear air-filled tires + single 12 in front air-filled tire (lockable swivel); air pump included

notes: Lightweight jogging single (26.25 lb) with 16 in rear + 12 in front air-filled tires — a trail/run stroller, closest in role to the owned BOB Alterrain Pro rather than to the city/shopping goal. Unfolded length 54 in with front wheel locked (49 in unlocked). Clek Liing attaches via the Joovy Universal Car Seat Adapter (adapter-joovy-universal). DTC listed at $339.90 but currently backordered (Joovy states 'Estimated Back in Stock Date is August 2026'), so marked out of stock at DTC; available via Amazon (price not machine-readable, left null).
